newsitem.title: USA: Clinton proposes to tax kerosene as diesel.
newsitem.headline: Clinton proposes to tax kerosene as diesel.

text.p: The Clinton administration proposed Thursday to impose a 24.3 cents a gallon tax on kerosene used as diesel fuel from July 1, 1998.
"Exceptions would be provided for aviation fuel and, to the extent provided in the regulations, for feedstock uses," according to the White House's proposal.
"In addition, special refund rules would apply in certain cases of kerosene used for heating purposes," it said.
The tax was designed to ensure that those who blended kerosene in diesel did not escape the 24.3 ct tax which is already imposed on unblended, undyed diesel fuel.
The tax on kerosene was expected to yield $200 million between 1998 and 2002.
